purpose: Primary-source manifest for a bounded reconciliation of CSI prime money, GTI subcontract forecasts, GEO revenue-recognition statements, and unavailable payment records.

key_quotes.quote: Our GTI Transportation Division also recently entered into an emergency contract to provide air operations support for ICE, which is expected to generate up to approximately $16 million in revenues over a nine-month period, assuming the contract runs through its full term.
Our third quarter results reflect an increase in our GTI secure transportation revenues. This increase was primarily driven by our new emergency contract to provide air operations in support for ICE.
The increase in our secure transportation segment was primarily driven by our new contract to provide air operation support for ICE, which was activated in the third quarter of 2023.
The new five-year contract is expected to generate approximately $25 million in annualized revenues for GEO.
the support services that we provide under our ICE air transportation subcontract continued to steadily increase throughout 2025.

sources.boundary: Company statements are primary evidence of what GEO publicly represented, not independent proof of payment or cash collection.
Structured reporting absence only; not proof that a subcontract or payment did not exist.
